description: Department of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources - The Fishing Gear Marking Regulations No. 1 of 2015
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, establishing new legal requirements for fishing gear marking. It creates binding legal obligations for fishing boat owners/operators and falls under the category of "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation," which are characteristic of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
